name: CM37_the_core_is_kept
origins: user requirement 2026-10-21 (ensure our core model features are never lost or forgotten, as laws)
statement: The core is kept: the core ledger (cards/ledger/core) names every law with its statement and witness, every goal with its target, and every registry, command and verify section. Verify and every cycle fail when one is lost, changed or a goal weakened, until the change is accepted with a reason (`cardmodel cycle ledger --accept --reason`), which archives the previous ledger (CM14) and records an amendment. Growth is recorded; a loss never passes silently.
